definition.en: A group of places studied together.
definition.zh: 放在一起研究的一组地方。

definition.en: A narrow sea passage between land areas.
definition.zh: 陆地之间较窄的海上通道。

definition.en: River reaches connected to one another.
An average for the same calendar month over many years.
definition.zh: 把多年中同一个月份的资料求平均。

definition.en: A large-scale movement of air whose winds change with the seasons.
definition.zh: 随季节转变风向的大范围空气环流。

definition.en: A coastal plant community, such as the mangroves at Sungei Buloh.
definition.zh: 海岸上的植物群落，例如双溪布洛的红树林。

definition.en: A field built along a slope and held in place by a wall.
definition.zh: 沿山坡修建、用墙挡护的田地。

definition.en: An organisation of neighbouring countries that joined at different times.
definition.zh: 邻近国家组成的组织，各国在不同时候加入。

definition.en: Working together on shared matters, such as conservation.
definition.zh: 在共同事务上携手行动，如保育。
